text:
Ravi: Customer request: hard 'burst fallback' option for reserved pools. If burst > threshold, auto-route new requests to cheaper compatible model. Need product constraints + infra feasibility.

Nora: Technically doable. Two main knobs: sliding-token-threshold and fallback_policy(list of models + max-latency-delta). Need routing priority & gradual ramp behavior.

Sam: ML constraint: must validate fallback models vs customer's prompt set. Recommend per-tenant fallback_models + max_semantic_delta param to avoid surprise regressions.

Elena: Ops: auto-fallback changes tail latency and can hide capacity problems. Propose circuit-breaker style: trigger only if pool_util>90% AND spillover>0 for 3m; ramp 10%->50%->100% over 15m while monitoring error/latency; emit alerts on engage.

Ravi: Billing and customer expectations?

Omar: Customers want determinism. Two asks: notify when fallback starts (webhook + console notice) and option to bill fallback at reserved rate or hosted rate based on contract. Need billing flag.

billing-bot: created event type 'fallback_usage' (fields: tenant_id,pool_id,fallback_model,tokens,rate_schema). Exported to bigquery.daily.

Nora: Implementation plan:
1) extend routing policy to include fallback_rules.
2) emit metrics: fallback_active{pool,tenant,model} and fallback_transition_count.
3) control plane: UI toggle + webhook notifications.
4) feature-flagged rollout for pilots.

Sam: Add small eval harness: run fallback model against ~200 sample prompts, compute semantic drift (Qscore). Accept if mean Qscore drop < 5%.

Elena: Quick runbook snippet to disable fallback:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://control-plane/api/pools/<POOL>/fallback:disable
```

Nora: PromQL to detect runaway fallback loops:
```
sum(rate(fallback_transition_count[5m])) by (pool_id) > 5
```

Ravi: Pilot gating checklist:
- fallback_rules config deployed and documented
- single-customer canary for 72h
- dashboards: fallback_active, p95 latency, error_rate, cost_delta
- notification path (console + webhook) working
- billing events flowing to BQ

Omar: I'll draft the customer-facing terms and the console notice.

Ravi: Timeline: prototype in 2 sprints, pilot in week 3, beta after pilot sign-off. Action items assigned above. Raise objections to bill-at-hosted default now or we'll proceed with that default and allow enterprise exceptions.
